concerns.text: The target construct is the impact of ALLOYING (concentration-dependent), but the training set is solute/impurity diffusion rows spanning varying `concentration_at_percent`, and concentration is neither used as a model feature nor controlled/stratified in the linear inference. If activation energy varies with solute concentration, the size_mismatch coefficient conflates solute identity with concentration effects. Specify how concentration is handled: restrict to dilute-limit rows, include concentration as a covariate, or justify its exclusion.

SC-002 requires 'Bootstrap p-value < 0.05' but no method for computing a bootstrap p-value is stated (e.g., percentile inversion of the CI, or fraction of resampled coefficients crossing zero). Name the procedure and the resample count (the ≥10,000 figure appears only for the CI) so the test is reproducible.

The Linear Regression is described as extracting the significance of `size_mismatch`, but the feature set includes electronegativity_diff and valence_electron_diff. State whether the inferential model is univariate (size_mismatch only) or multivariate; if multivariate, the single-descriptor 'no Bonferroni needed' claim in item 5 needs restating.
